title: FileVault Full-Disk Encryption & Key Escrow/Recovery for macOS (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Encrypt every Mac and never lose a recovery key
problem: FileVault protects data at rest — but only if it's enforced, escrowed, and recoverable. This solution deploys FileVault full-disk encryption via Microsoft Intune with proper recovery-key escrow, rotation, and recovery workflow, plus the SecureToken enablement that FileVault depends on — so data is protected and you can always recover a locked-out Mac, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how FileVault + SecureToken work on Apple Silicon/T2, personal vs institutional recovery keys, Intune escrow, and the recovery model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Intune enrollment, disk-encryption policy, SecureToken/bootstrap-token, Entra groups, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.

Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named FileVault disk-encryption policy, enable escrow, handle SecureToken/bootstrap token, validate key escrow, and run the recovery workflow, then pilot and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — FileVault/escrow discovery, per-device encryption + key-escrow validation, an encryption coverage/recovery-key report, safe remediation of unencrypted/unescrowed devices, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (encrypted, key escrowed, recovery works; SecureToken issues) plus Best Practices for key rotation and recovery.
short: Deploy FileVault full-disk encryption via Intune with recovery-key escrow, rotation, SecureToken enablement, and a proven recovery workflow — data protected, Macs always recoverable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Deploy FileVault full-disk encryption via Intune with recovery-key escrow, rotation, SecureToken enablement, and a proven recovery workflow — data protected, Macs always recoverable.
